method: Read native enemy rows, follow weapon references to serialized proficiency dictionaries, then resolve proficiency rows and prefab categories. No native source, bytes, or geometry reproduced.
semantics: DamageCalculator.StartEngageAttack sets proficiency success independently of damage; these full-slot skills require complete slot success in ordinary non-cheat attacks.

DummyDamageInfo copies m_ProfSuccess, queries native immunity and effect applicability, and clears applicability for nonimmune damaging attacks that deal zero damage. Harmless actions can apply effects without HP damage.
Dodge clears m_ProfAffect and m_ProfImmune. Natural immunity can also yield no effect.
Guardian Ward changes eligible m_ProfAffect from true to false and sets m_ProfImmune true before native effect application. A final immune flag alone does not identify its cause.
falsePositiveCautions: Observe the affected victim, attack proficiency and success, active Guard and Ward equipment, original applicability, and resulting effect state. Absence of a status alone is insufficient.
CharacterStats.HasImmunity includes personal and party immunities. Wet suppresses native immunity. Snapshot these without changing them.
Never invoke ProficiencyBase.IsIgnore as a diagnostic: it consumes Unity random state.
ProficiencyStunned.AddToDummy declines a new Stunned or Dazed record when Stunned, Dazed, or Entangle is already present.
Poison and Curse are stored in character stats, not the timed suffering-proficiency dictionary. Existing poison at the stage cap or duplicate curses can conceal an application.
An inactive or expired Guard control and a non-Guardian control remain necessary for attribution.
Enemy skill choice is not guaranteed: trollA has chanceToProf approximately 0.3 and two configured skills.
witchA proficiency enWitchStun resolves prefab5538 ProficiencyEntangle, so its name does not establish a Ward-covered stun.

readOnlyObservation.timedEffects: Read CharacterDummy.m_SufferingProficiencies keys Stunned, Dazed, and Entangle plus their record counts/timers.
readOnlyObservation.constraints: Copy bounded primitive/enum snapshots only; do not call setters, IsIgnore, random-curse selection, attack methods, or UI callbacks.

limits: Candidate membership and native mechanics are source evidence, not completed Ward validation.
World locations are deliberately omitted because they belong to a transient fixture save.
No online peer agreement or complete four-category live coverage is claimed.
